_comment: Your coves as places people live (scripts/settlement.gd). haven: a cove with a tavern you open to the Brethren; pirate companies come to work from it (Brethren.coves): each pays fee_per_man gold a day for each of its men (plunder sold, drink drunk), sends recruits_per_company sailors a day to your tavern, gives the cove away (visibility_per_company a day) and draws settlers. people: folk who come to live by a base, from its buildings and its havens (per day, toward cap), and leave when it's hungry, unpaid or raided. settlers: up to max named people, one of each trade, arriving when there are enough people (needs_people); each has a boon while they think well of you, and asks things of you: grant (pay from the treasury or the storehouse, or build it before the time's up) and they're yours; refuse or forget and they remember. Below leave_at they go, and talk. supply: runs between your bases, carried by a ship laid up at the source dock.

tavern_keeper.name: Tavern keeper
tavern_keeper.boon_text: Sends sailors your way: +0.3 recruits a day

smith.name: Smith
smith.boon_text: Building goes faster: +0.4 days of work a day

fence.name: Fence
fence.boon_text: Gets better prices from the smugglers: +10%

shipwright.name: Shipwright
shipwright.boon_text: Hulls on the slip go faster: +0.4 days of work a day

rum.text: wants 20 rum for the tavern before the next ships come in

food.text: asks for 40 food for the sick and the hungry

naval_stores.text: needs 15 naval stores: pitch, tar and cordage

loan.text: asks for 150 gold to set up properly, and swears to pay it back

stockade.text: wants a stockade raised: there are men here nobody trusts

battery.text: wants guns on the point before the navy comes calling

warehouse.text: wants a proper warehouse, so the goods stop rotting on the beach

shipyard.text: wants a shipyard to work in

quiet.text: asks you to keep the Brethren away for a while: too many strangers know the way here

_rivals: Bases of the named pirate captains (scripts/rival_bases.gd). A pirate captain of fame found_fame or more without a base makes one in an unclaimed cove (found_chance a month). Each month it grows (garrison_growth men to garrison_max, gold_per_fame x fame gold, a gun battery for fort_cost up to fort_max), and the navy may burn it (burn_chance, x 1 + heat x burn_per_heat on its cruising ground). Raid: your able men / men_per_point + swordplay against their men / men_per_point + fort x fort_strength + fame/20. Selling it to a governor: sell_gold, the Brethren's standing -sell_pirates, and a feud.
